title: Automated Brick Schema Knowledge Graph Completion Across Buildings
abstract: arXiv:2610.27339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Brick schema represents building equipment, sensors, spaces, and the relationships between them as typed, multi-relational graphs, providing machine-readable metadata that supports generalizable control applications. Current methods for producing complete Brick models require extensive manual examination of building schematics and point lists. We observe that as Brick models are knowledge graphs, inferring missing relations is naturally posed as a knowledge graph completion problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of knowledge graph completion to Brick model generation. We compare three methods, gradient-boosted trees, Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking, and CompGCN, on the relations feeds, hasPart, and hasPoint, which account for the majority of the schematic-reading work in building a Brick model by hand. translated_title: 跨建筑的Brick模式知识图谱自动补全
translated_abstract: Brick模式将建筑设备、传感器、空间及其相互关系表示为带类型的多关系图，提供机器可读的元数据，从而支持可泛化的控制应用。目前生成完整Brick模型的方法需要对建筑图纸和点位列表进行大量的人工检查。我们观察到，由于Brick模型本质上是知识图谱，推断其中缺失的关系可以自然地表述为一个知识图谱补全问题。据我们所知，这是首次将知识图谱补全技术应用于Brick模型生成。我们在feeds、hasPart和hasPoint这三种关系上比较了三种方法——梯度提升树、成对Brick关系排序和CompGCN——这些关系占到了人工构建Brick模型时阅读图纸工作的绝大部分。模型在留出的MORTAR建筑数据以及分布外的Kaggle和Building Time Series数据集上进行了评估。
tldr: 本文首次将知识图谱补全技术应用于Brick建筑元数据模型的自动生成，通过比较三种方法自动推断建筑设备、传感器和空间之间的缺失关系，从而大幅减少人工建模的工作量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first application of knowledge graph completion to Brick model generation, comparing three methods to automatically infer missing relations (feeds, hasPart, hasPoint) across buildings and significantly reduce manual modeling effort.
